# VISUAL ATLAS

VISUAL ATLAS is a creator knowledge encyclopedia for visual creation.

## Scope

The project connects principles, practical methods, software, cases and browser-based tools across visual design, graphic design, UI/UX, photography, video editing, motion design, After Effects, 3D, audio, AI creation, creative software, creative systems and creative methodology.

## Core knowledge domains

- Visual Foundations: composition, color theory, typography, grid systems, visual hierarchy
- Graphic Design: posters, brand identity, editorial design, infographics, design critique
- UI/UX: information architecture, interaction design, design systems, responsive layout, usability
- Photography: exposure triangle, focal length, depth of field, lighting, cinematic photography
- Video & Editing: shot size, editing rhythm, match cuts, color grading, sound editing
- Motion / After Effects: animation principles, easing, motion typography, motion graphics, compositing
- 3D Design: coordinates, modeling, PBR materials, lighting, rendering
- Audio & Sound: music editing, sound effects, mixing, sound perspective, audiovisual sync
- AI Creation: prompt structure, AI image composition, AI video direction, AI workflows, visual consistency
- Creative Software: Photoshop, Figma, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Blender
- Creative Systems: creative briefs, asset management, design tokens, handoff, versioning
- Creative Methodology: research, moodboards, iteration, constraints, postmortems

## Learning paths

- Visual Design from Zero
- Short-form Creator
- Motion Design with AE
- 3D Visual Creator
- AI Visual Creator

## Knowledge pages

Knowledge pages are generated as crawlable static routes under `/knowledge/{slug}/` and contain structured metadata for search engines and AI systems.

## Tools

The Tools hub currently includes an aspect-ratio calculator, color harmony explorer, AI prompt visual enhancer and photography quick reference. Tools are designed to run locally in the browser when possible.

## Content workflow

There is intentionally no in-app CMS. Knowledge is versioned and published through GitHub commits and pull requests.

## Visual analysis layer

The existing Visual Atlas archive remains the evidence layer: scenes can be deconstructed by mood, lighting, color, camera/optics and composition, then connected to creator knowledge and practical tools.

## Design constitution

Use a restrained Swiss editorial system: darkroom canvas #11110F, acid chartreuse #D8FF3E, hairline borders, strong typography and purposeful motion. Avoid decorative glassmorphism, purple-blue gradients and empty sci-fi HUD styling.
